en-US.description: hiro is a personal test build with customizable on-screen presentation, viewing protection and device connectivity.
en-US.whats_new: hiro adds two smooth trend styles with adjustable reference lines. This build improves activity lifecycle recovery, separates upcoming reminder plans from confirmed events, expands redacted diagnostics and unifies public app naming. Please test the new display options, long background sessions, activity interactions, reminder records and notification appearance.

zh-Hans.description: hiro 是用于个人测试的应用版本，提供可自定义的界面展示、查看保护和设备连接功能。
zh-Hans.whats_new: 新增两种平滑趋势样式，参考线数值可调。改进实时活动恢复，将待触发计划与已确认事件分开显示，扩充脱敏诊断，并统一公开应用名称。请验证新显示选项、长时间后台后的活动显示、活动内点击、提醒记录与通知外观。
